color-picker.$description: Colour picker: an area of saturation and brightness, a hue strip and an opacity strip, inputs for the channels, and preset colours.

area-height.$description: The height of the saturation and brightness area.

strip-height.$description: The height of the hue and opacity strips.

thumb-size.$description: The handle moved on the area and the strips.

preview-size.$description: The square showing the colour beside the strips.

checker-size.$description: One square of the pattern under a see-through colour.

checker-light.$description: The light squares under a see-through colour.

checker-dark.$description: The dark squares under a see-through colour.

strip.$description: The hue strip and the opacity strip.

thumb.$description: The handle on the area and the strips: its ring, and `focus`.
